report.configuration: identical source/viewer size, fps, JPEG quality, input workload, build and process; only per-host-thread test-only retained scheduling switch differs
report.lease_policy: new session per arm occurrence; per-session 25s checked budget includes setup, no renewal; bounded teardown excluded from measurement

sessions.budget: 25s checked including setup and after each sample; synchronous fixture operations and teardown have their own bounded waits, so this is not a strict wall-clock process cap
sessions.endpoints: injection before click wire requests; recipient observed after fixture dispatch; app commit request submitted; actual GL readback marker verified; exact client presentation feedback observed. Includes polling/readback/test feedback overhead, not physical input or scanout; no cross-machine claim.

environment.gl_renderer: production headless Smithay GLES; driver identity not queried
environment.topology: single-process owned dual Wayland displays and loopback authenticated TCP
